vulnerability.name: Cross-Site Request Forgery
vulnerability.description: Attacks that force users to execute unwanted actions
patterns: CSRF via SVG or image upload
vulnerability.impact: Unauthorized actions performed on behalf of authenticated users
vulnerability.mitigation: Use CSRF tokens, SameSite cookies, and verify request origins

findings.title: Vulnerability found
findings.explanation: The function allows a user to call the airDrop function without checking if it is a Cross-Site Request Forgery request.
findings.impact: An attacker could potentially manipulate token distribution by making unauthorized requests.
findings.execution_path_diagram:
```
	+-------+
	| User |
	+-------+
	             |       |
	         +--->+ airDrop()
	                 ^|
	                 | CSRF Attack|
	                 |        |
	                 +------->+ ModifierEntrancy Contract
	                           ^|
	                           | Token Distribution |
```
exploitation_steps: An attacker creates a malicious website.
The user visits the attacker's website.
The attacker uses CSRF to call the airDrop() function on behalf of the user.
findings.exploitation_conditions: An attacker can trick the user into making a request to the airDrop() function.
findings.remediation: Implement CSRF protection by adding a CSRF token or using secure methods for form submission.

findings.title: Vulnerability found
findings.explanation: This function allows state change based on the user's address, which can be manipulated via a malicious website through a CSRF attack.
findings.impact: An authenticated user's credit balance may be reduced unintentionally.
findings.execution_path_diagram:
```
user -> malicious site -> smart contract - withdraw(amount)
```
exploitation_steps: User visits malicious website with embedded form.
Form submits CSRF request to the contract's withdraw function.
findings.exploitation_conditions: Attacker can reach the affected function via a web-based request.
findings.remediation: Use CSRF tokens or SameSite cookies for form submissions to prevent CSRF attacks.
